summary: Testing V4 features completed successfully. All 18 requested features verified: 1) Amount in Words with Indian numbering (Lakh, Crore) displays correctly in LoanForm, InvestmentForm, InsuranceForm, AssetForm, and AccountForm for all amount fields, 2) Calendar popover opens correctly for all date fields in LoanForm, InvestmentForm, InsuranceForm, and AssetForm, 3) MyExpenses shows monetary totals (₹ amounts) for Fixed Paid/Pending and Variable Paid/Pending, 4) Fixed/Variable Expenses cards are clickable and navigate to dedicated pages, 5) FixedExpenses and VariableExpenses pages load correctly with expense lists, 6) Smart Back Button on MyExpenses and MyCreditCards navigates to Home (/), 7) Add Insurance shortcut appears in AssetForm when isInsured is toggled on, 8) Add Insurance shortcut preserves AssetForm state when navigating to InsuranceForm and back.
